title: Designer Marks
text: Fauna Genomics, first results. The burrowers' genome has blocks no evolution wrote: clean repeats, a promoter library, a kill switch that was never thrown. Someone bred them to till soil. The spitters' acid is tuned to this world's crust. Someone terraformed here before us.

choices.label: Look for who
choices.reply: The marks carry no name. The sequence formatting matches our own archive's conventions.

choices.label: Tell the colonists
choices.reply: Logged and shared. Some colonists find it comforting that life here was meant to be lived with. Others don't.
